results.title: Wilbert Ross keeps mum on rumored romance with Bea Binene
results.description: Wilbert Ross had a pretty straightforward answer when asked about Bea Binene. Or at least, it sounded that way. “She’s my partner in many things right now,” Wilbert said during his appearance on “Fast Talk with Boy Abunda.” Partner? How? Purely business, or something else? That line alone is enough to keep fans guessing. Wilbert and Bea are working together on several projects. They have a business together too, Sunset Avenue Shades and merchandise. They are also currently working on a series and an upcoming movie, an adaptation of the Thai horror-comedy “Pee Mak.” There is certainly no shortage of reasons for them to spend time together. Still, fans have been noticing their chemistry for some time now, with some convinced that their closeness goes beyond being workmates. Wilbert did not exactly put an end to the speculation. Instead of simply calling Bea a co-star or colleague, he referred to her as his partner and added, “We support each other.” Bea also had something sweet to say when Wilbert celebrated his 10th anniversary in showbiz. In a surprise video message, she wished him well and told him she was always proud of him. Neither Wilbert's interview nor Bea's message confirms that they are romantically involved. But their answers are unlikely to stop the speculation, either. For now, Wilbert and Bea are partners in business, television and, soon, film. As for whether there is something more between them, that remains something only the two of them know.
